title: Dimensions & Dungeons
description: Explore a new world full of undiscovered possibilities, with new dimensions, bosses, mobs and structures.
body:
_Explore a new world full of undiscovered possibilities, with new dimensions, bosses, mobs and structures. This mod is waiting for you to start an incredible journey!_

~~Please be aware that this mod is in alpha so expect bugs and unfinished features. We will keep updating the mod with time so stay tuned for updates.~~

**This mod requires Geckolib to function properly.**


# 
# FINISHED FEATURES:

## **Eternal Forest and Crystal Abysm Dimension:**

- **New biomes:** Eternal Forest and Small Forest Biome, Eternal Dark Forest and Small Dark Forest Biome, the Eternal Desert Biome, Amethyst Grottoes, Amazonian Hollows, Caverns of Hell and more...

- **New mobs:** Magic Fairy, Woodsper Monster, Friendly Goblin, Crystal Golem and new bosses.

- **New important items:** New keys for dimensional travel, a dimensional reverser to go back to the overworld and a huge variety of new minerals and their respective armor and tools.

- **New structures:** An ancient dungeon, goblin huts and villages, a mysterious massive tree, an aracnid cavern and new desert pyramids.

- **New flowers:** Purple allium, light blue orchid, pink cactus flower and pink lily of the valley.

- **New food:** Blackberry, Eternal apple, glowsapple Amethyst carrot, Garnet carrot and Amazonite carrot.

# 
# **UPCOMING FEATURES:**

- One new dimension:  The Hot Plains.
- New useful items.
- New foods.
- New building blocks.
- New mobs.
- New structures.
- New biomes.
  
# **GUIDE**

1. First, you have to find the new hard dungeon underground or the new pillager dungeon and loot the chests to get **1 Eternal Forest key fragment**.

These fragments are essential for crafting the key for the Eternal Forest dimension.

### CRAFTING RECIPE:

![Eternal Forest Key](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1a6989d620b315732bf2ffcd60224728759bdf07.png)

This key isnt useful by itself, to make it properly usable you need to craft the **Dimensional Traveller**.

CRAFTING RECIPE:

![Dimensional Traveller](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29d132f8d2207ae6a18f92c765bc90af60ad5230.png)

2. With the key, you have to right click on the Dimensional Traveller to activate the portal to the Eternal Forest or Crystal Abysm dimension (First, you have to go to the Eternal Forest). To travel to the dimension, you need an ender pearl on your main hand and right click on the activated Dimensional Traveller.

To go back to the overworld, you need to craft the Dimensional Reverser.

CRAFTING RECIPE:

![Dimensional Reverser](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afea2af8ce8a41e1a234fb3e6653b9dd55d17b16.png)

To use it, you just have to right click, and you will go back to the overworld.
